items.q: Is there a dancing banana emoji?
items.a: Yes — the original, right here, free and transparent. Add it to Discord, Slack, Telegram or anywhere.

items.q: Is there a dancing banana emoji to copy and paste?
items.a: Not as a Unicode text emoji you can type like 🍌 — the dancing banana is an animated image. So you add it as a **custom emoji/sticker**: grab the free file above and upload it to Discord, Slack, Telegram and the rest.

items.q: How do I add the dancing banana to Discord?
items.a: Download the [128px emoji GIF](#discord), then Server Settings → Emoji → Upload Emoji → pick the file. It’s pre-cropped — no editing needed.

items.q: Can I use the dancing banana on Slack, Telegram or Twitch?
items.a: Yes — every platform has its own pre-sized file and 3-step guide above: [Slack](#slack), [Telegram](#telegram), [Twitch](#twitch).

items.q: Where does the dancing banana come from?
items.a: It’s the original Dancing Banana, made by Trym Stene in 1999. [Read the story →](/dancing-banana-gif-meme/)
